items.text: Ladd McConkey now has been ruled out with a concussion.
items.why: Head injury mid-game vs KC; evaluated then ruled out.
items.implication: Remaining Chargers WRs (Johnston etc.) see boost rest of game/ROS risk.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to Quentin Johnston and others

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.implication: Palmer and others absorb WR snaps/targets vs LV.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings practice squad Tuesday).
items.why: Ankle injury; pregame workout failed; only limited practice Friday after DNPs.
items.implication: Browns backfield thin; McLaughlin/Estime handle carries vs BAL.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.why: Groin injury added late Friday; popped on report.
items.implication: Colts TE streaming needed; targets redistribute to Downs/Allen.

items.text: Actives today include: Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren.
items.implication: Full roles for Olave/Kamara vs NYG; Williams returns for CHI.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active.
items.why: Confirmed active on Titans side of TEN@IND.
items.implication: Spears available in Titans backfield opposite IND.

items.text: Both officially active. (TreVeyon Henderson and AJ Brown context from likely-to-play).
items.why: Ankle issues cleared; AJ Brown activated/returning.
items.implication: NE offense near full health vs NYJ; Henderson role intact.

items.text: Whoa! Popped up on injury report but still surprising. Juwan Johnson, Friermuth and Higbee among my fave streamer TE's ...
items.why: Warren inactive opens TE streamer path.

items.text: If I have to start a NYG RB I'm still starting Cam as I still think his explosiveness gives him best chance at a score. Esp against NO. But it's certainly a riskier start now. He's more of a flex than RB 2. Updated: Cam Skattebo at RB 28, Najee Harris at RB 33.
items.why: Fumbles and rotation change; still explosive upside vs NO.
items.implication: Startable but flex/RB28 range; prefer over some like DK in spots.
items.conflict: Conflicts with pure usage downgrade if volume tanks

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Expectation of larger Najee Harris role with Skattebo downgraded but still mixed.
items.why: Poor YOE + 4 fumbles; sources say Najee larger role, all 4 RBs active.
items.implication: Riskier flex; split work vs NO reduces ceiling.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers starting Skattebo over pure flex risk

items.text: Summary of weekend FantasyFootball reports: GAME-TIME DECISION Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren, Mike Evans, Christian Kirk. EXPECTED TO PLAY Caleb Williams, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson, DK Metcalf, Pat Freiermuth, Kenyon Sadiq. NOT EXPECTED Deebo Samuel, Jacory Croskey-Merritt, Sean Tucker. ACTIVATED Jaydon Blue.
items.why: Weekend reports compilation for Sunday decisions.
items.implication: Monitor last-min for GTDs; start expected; fade not expected.

items.text: Mike Evans vs. WSH (WR4) - loves due to Washington defense buffet for pass catchers.
items.why: Commanders D nightmare vs WRs; usage bankable despite GTD.
items.implication: Strong start even with status watch.
items.opportunity: High target share vs soft pass D

items.text: Drake London vs. CHI (WR6) - loves for bankable usage.
George Kittle vs. WSH (TE3) - loves Washington D weakness at TE.
Kyren Williams vs. ARI (RB5) - loves elite recent usage and soft run D.
items.why: Volume elite; ARI leaks vs run.

items.text: Javonte Williams @ GB (RB8) and Rhamondre Stevenson vs. NYJ (RB9) - loves volume and leaking run defenses; Javonte goal-line role.
Jaylen Waddle vs. SEA (WR28) and Emeka Egbuka vs. PIT (WR34) - hates due to ugly matchups and shaky QB/feeding.
items.why: Tough Ds; limited recent targets for Egbuka.

items.text: Kyle Pitts vs. CHI (TE18), J.K. Dobbins vs. SEA (RB27), Bo Nix vs. SEA (QB23), Justin Herbert @ KC (QB25) - hates for matchups, roles, and low totals.
items.why: Hard matchups, thin roles, low team totals/scoring ruts.
